message:
The independent qa verdict on d7674ea22328 is needs-follow-up; The 3 repair rounds for arcadia/pin-work-monitor-malformed-record in this production run (epoch 52) are spent, and the latest repaired head still failed. Findings (report artifacts/qa/pull-requests/pmark-arcadia/2086/d7674ea22328723e3c8645f34aef061c4128f5e5/attempts/2026-11-05T03-51-45-600Z-4e85fa70b8f2/qa-report.md):
  1. [medium] Settlement records cite an Agent Ask id that does not match the archived Ask — evidence: The Plan's next_action and the new MISSION_LOG entry both cite Agent Ask auto-settle-arcadia-pin-work-monitor-malformed-record-002649b7b774. The only Ask in the settled tree is archived as agent-ask-complete-pin-work-monitor-malformed-record-b57bfe06d7f5.yaml, with request_id complete-pin-work-monitor-malformed-record-b57bfe06d7f5. No file or record in the patch carries the auto-settle id except the settlement commit subject. The preceding MISSION_LOG entry shown in the diff cites Agent Ask complete-cover-retired-reland-20261103, which has the same complete-* form as this archived request_id.… — recommendation: Have the host settlement cite an id that resolves to the archived Ask, or record the mapping from the auto-settle id to the archived request_id in the managed documents. The fix belongs in the settlement writer, not in the test.
  2. [medium] Operator QA plan step 5: the prescribed output cannot show the criterion holds — evidence: Step 5 runs git show on tests/work-monitor-failures.test.ts and expects that output to show 'The change touches only tests/work-monitor-failures.test.ts' and that proof of the file, lint and tsc passing comes from required CI. A single file's content shows neither which files changed nor any CI result. Step 2 lists 5 changed files, and no step explains that 4 of them are governed settlement records outside this criterion. No step tells the operator to inspect the required checks on the head. — recommendation: Rewrite step 5 to use the step 2 name-status output, separate the test file from the named settlement records, and add a concrete read of the required check results for head d7674ea22328723e3c8645f34aef061c4128f5e5 with the expected SUCCESS outcome.
  3. [low] Operator QA plan step 4: a diff cannot show the other tests pass — evidence: Step 4 expects git diff output to show that 'every other test in that file passes unchanged'. A diff can show the other tests were not edited, but not that they pass. The only execution step in the plan, step 6, runs node scripts/preservation-self-check.mjs, which does not run this test file according to the recorded stdout. — recommendation: Have step 4 point to a concrete pass result for the named test file, such as the retained completion report or a focused vitest command with its expected 7 passed result.
Failed or unestablished review checks:
  - Managed documents: fail — The status flip to done is consistent, and current_action moves to pin-recovery-unparseable-time-order in both PROJECT.md and the Plan. The Plan and MISSION_LOG, however, cite Agent Ask auto-settle-arcadia-pin-work-monitor-malformed-record-002649b7b774, while the archived Ask's request_id is complete-pin-work-monitor-malformed-record-b57bfe06d7f5. The archived note's claim that no auto-settle id is cited in the tree is also false at this head.
  - Operator QA plan: fail — Steps 1, 2 and 6 are concrete and have observable results. Step 5 expects a single file's content to prove a touched-files and required-CI criterion, which that output cannot show. Step 4 expects a diff to show that other tests pass, which a diff also cannot show.
remedy: Read the report and the findings above; fix the candidate yourself (a new head is reviewed afresh), or, after judging the verdict wrong, mark https://github.com/pmark/arcadia/pull/2086 ready and rerun it with `arcadia qa pr https://github.com/pmark/arcadia/pull/2086 --rerun`. Nothing integrates meanwhile.
